room_rent.note: Fixed daily cap varies by SI band. ICU at 1.5x normal room limit. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: cataract, maternity, cancer, cardiac, joint replacement, etc.
sub_limits.note: 23 disease/procedure categories sub-limited per policy year (e.g. cataract ₹25K-₹50K, normal delivery ₹25K-₹50K, CABG ₹1.5L-₹2L, joint replacement ₹1.5L-₹2.5L). Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI or disease sub-limit, whichever lower.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability norms

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most); 36 months (joint replacement, osteoarthritis, maternity, bariatric)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 20 conditions at 24 months (cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, etc.); 4 conditions at 36 months

maternity.note: Sub-limited per schedule (normal delivery ₹25K-₹50K, C-section ₹30K-₹60K by SI). Max 2 lifetime claims. Pre/post-natal excluded. Portability/migration not applicable.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% added per claim-free year; reduced by 10% per claim year; max 100%

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Up to SI; disease sub-limits apply

post_hosp.note: Up to SI; disease sub-limits apply

day_care.note: Plus any other procedures agreed by insurer requiring <24hr hospitalisation due to technology advancement

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (disease sub-limits apply)
ayush.note: Must be in AYUSH Hospital; preventive/rejuvenation and OPD excluded

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned

ambulance.note: Over and above disease sub-limits but subject to SI availability; covers transfer to hospital, hospital-to-hospital, and discharge home if medically required

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited (disease sub-limit or 50% of SI, whichever lower)
modern_treatments.note: 12 listed procedures including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy (hematopoietic), etc.

consumables.note: Consumables/Non-Medical Expenses Cover available as optional add-on for additional premium; covers List I items from Annexure II

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states treatment must be taken in India only (Section 7.1.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; maternity and bariatric surgery benefits not portable

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, OPD treatment, dental (unless injury), durable medical equipment post-discharge
